title.v: Báo cáo thống kê đơn hàng

grid.order: ma_ct asc, ma_job desc, so_job asc

options.query: select ma_ngv, ten_ngv%l from dmngv where ma_ct = '@@voucherCode' and status = 1 order by stt
select ma_ttct, ten_ttct%l from dmttct where ma_ct = '@@voucherCode' and status = 1 order by stt

query.text: declare @strKey nvarchar(3000) exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh left join vdmcangdi d on a.ma_noi_di = d.ma_noi_di left join vdmcangden f on a.ma_noi_den = f.ma_noi_den', 'b.ma_unit, c.ten_kh, d.ten_noi_di, f.ten_noi_den', '@@key', @strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId

finding.text:
declare @strKey nvarchar(3000), @strDetailKey nvarchar(3000); set @strDetailKey = '' if @ma_kien <> '' set @strDetailKey = @strDetailKey + ' and x.ma_kien like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@ma_kien) + '%''' if @strDetailKey <> '' set @strDetailKey = ' and exists(select 1 from v61 x where a.id = x.id ' + @strDetailKey + ')'
set @strKey = 'ngay_ct between ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct1, 112) + ''' and ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct2, 112) + ''' and ' + @strFinding + ' and ' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionGetUnitIDRightKeys(@@admin, @@userId, @ma_unit, 'a.unit_id') + @strDetailKey exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh left join vdmcangdi d on a.ma_noi_di = d.ma_noi_di left join vdmcangden f on a.ma_noi_den = f.ma_noi_den', 'b.ma_unit, c.ten_kh, d.ten_noi_di, f.ten_noi_den', '@@key', @strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId drop table #unitright
